🔥 omniget | Rust
🎯 Primary Use Case: A unified desktop application for downloading and managing various types of digital media, including online courses, videos, music, and books, with integrated tools for consumption and study.
✨ Key Features: • Download courses from Udemy and Hotmart • Download YouTube videos and other media from 1,800+ sites • Built-in course player, PDF/EPUB reader, and music library • Powered by yt-dlp
📖 Summary: OmniGet is a free, open-source desktop application for Windows, macOS, and Linux that simplifies downloading media from over 1,800 websites, including Udemy, Hotmart, and YouTube. It integrates a media player, EPUB reader, and music library, all powered by yt-dlp, ensuring user files remain on their local computer.
